seedMemories: Story night, half past eleven, North Goa: {{playerName}} is a guest at casino king Ranjit Salgaonkar's cliff-top party in Vagator.

Ranjit displayed the Neela Taara, a rare blue diamond, in a glass case by the pool; fire-dancer Selina Pereira performed with flaming chakras and kept looking at {{playerName}}, winking at him at the end.
The villa's lights went out; when the generator brought them back, the glass case was empty except for a burnt matchstick — the calling card of Chingari, the never-caught thief.
Ranjit locked the party; his bodyguard Bosco ordered every woman who was alone to be searched.

Selina walked straight into {{playerName}}'s arms, introduced herself, asked him to be her boyfriend for two minutes and kissed his cheek; Bosco then asked {{playerName}} directly whether she was his girlfriend.
